sources.snippet: Qwen3 Forced Aligner Align a text transcript to its audio and get per-unit start/end timestamps, powered by Qwen/Qwen3-ForcedAligner-.6B. Upload or record audio, paste the matching transcript, pick the language, and align. This UI also doubles as an API — see the "Use via API" link at the bottom of the page.

sources.snippet: The Qwen3-ASR family includes Qwen3-ASR-1.7B and Qwen3-ASR-.6B, which support language identification and ASR for 52 languages and dialects. Both leverage large-scale speech training data and the strong audio understanding capability of their foundation model, Qwen3-Omni. sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract In this work, we present Qwen3, the latest version of the Qwen model family. Qwen3 comprises a series of large language models (LLMs) designed to advance performance, efficiency, and multilingual capabilities.
